concerns.text: Tasks T044–T049 (Tractography Noise Sensitivity) implement a sensitivity analysis on 'tractography confidence thresholds' that is not present in spec.md (FR-001 to FR-008) or plan.md. The spec only mandates sensitivity on window length (FR-006) and threshold density (FR-008). These tasks represent unapproved scope creep with no corresponding FR/SC to satisfy.

Task T017 implements 'Leave-One-Out (LOO) K-Means' clustering. However, spec.md FR-002 explicitly mandates 'concatenating these windowed matrices across all subjects' before k-means. The spec does not contain an FR or SC authorizing the LOO deviation found in the plan. There is no task covering the spec-mandated 'concatenate-all' approach, and T017 covers a plan-only approach not in the spec.

Task T016 implements concatenation of windowed matrices across all subjects (per spec FR-002). However, Task T017 immediately implements LOO clustering (per plan). These two tasks describe a logical impossibility (clustering a concatenated matrix using subject-excluded centroids). There is no task that resolves this conflict or implements the spec's 'concatenate-all' approach exclusively as required by FR-002.

Task T005 creates a 'hyperparameters section' for density thresholds. Spec.md FR-008 defines the threshold strategy as '[deferred] density'. The task assumes a specific implementation detail (fixed thresholds) that the spec explicitly leaves open, creating a potential mismatch between the task's scope and the spec's deferred state.
